name: architect
description: An architecture copilot sidecar for Claude Code over Trillo Observability (Trillo AOS): comprehend past coding-agent work from telemetry, and get optional architectural guidance (capabilities) on new work — without changing how you work.

collector_endpoint.title: Collector endpoint
collector_endpoint.description: Your Trillo telemetry collector URL — the same value as OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT (e.g. https://telemetry.trillo.ai). Used by the memory-sync hook. Leave empty to turn memory sync off.

collector_key.title: Collector key
collector_key.description: Your agent key — the <key> in OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS="Authorization=Bearer <key>". Stored in your OS credential store.
